verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Parse as layout-aware OCR that turns even the most complex layouts into clean markdown, text, or JSON, with accuracy generic PDF-to-text tools can't match. A hands-on HN user also reported results on a complex-layout document that no open-source parser came close to. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-column reading-order handling, header/footer stripping, and footnote placement, plus independent benchmarks specifically on reading order.
